Resource Profile: MII PR Mikrobio Probe

Official URL: https://www.medizininformatik-initiative.de/fhir/modul-mikrobio/StructureDefinition/mii-pr-mikrobio-probe Version: 2027.0.0-ballot2
Active as of 2026-11-27 Computable Name: MII_PR_Mikrobio_Probe

Probe beschreibt das mikrobiologisch untersuchte Material. Das Profil leitet vom Bioproben-Basisprofil der MII-Biobank ab und ergaenzt die Erwartungen der mikrobiologischen Diagnostik.

Specimen describes the material examined microbiologically. The profile derives from MII_PR_Biobank_Specimen_Bioprobe_Core, a base profile written so that modules derive from it rather than implement it directly. Observation.specimen of every investigation profile in this module references it.

Ballot question 1 — can you supply a Specimen resource for every result? Every investigation profile here requires Observation.specimen. The HL7 EU Lab Semantic Workgroup states that the specimen shall always be represented explicitly in a Specimen resource, even where the LOINC code already carries it, so the question is deliverability rather than principle. Feedback from German laboratory practice is that one is frequently not produced. Full statement of the question on Specimen.

Specimen type

Specimen.type.coding:sct keeps the inherited binding to the biobank specimen type set. It is descendent-of 123038009 |Specimen| and therefore covers the microbiological specimen types; an own value set would be a subset without additional meaning. One gap: the root code 123038009 itself is excluded, so "specimen, unspecified" cannot be expressed. The binding is extensible, so the case remains a warning rather than an error.

Usages:

  • Refer to this Profile: MII PR Mikrobio Allgemeine Bestimmung (Identifizierung), MII PR Mikrobio Allgemeine Kultur, MII PR Mikrobio Antigen Antikoerper Quantitativ, MII PR Mikrobio Aviditaet... , MII PR Mikrobio Bartlett Score, MII PR Mikrobio CT Wert, MII PR Mikrobio Empfindlichkeit, MII PR Mikrobio Keimzahl, MII PR Mikrobio Allgemeine Mikroskopie, MII PR Mikrobio Molekulare Pathogenlast, MII PR Mikrobio MRGN Klasse, MII PR Mikrobio Nugent Score, MII PR Mikrobio Resistenzkategorie Status, MII PR Mikrobio Resistenzmechanismen Determinanten, MII PR Mikrobio Spezifische Bestimmung, MII PR Mikrobio Spezifische Mikroskopie, MII PR Mikrobio Titer, MII PR Mikrobio Virulenzfaktor and MII PR Mikrobio Voraussichtliche Empfindlichkeit
  • Examples for this Profile: Specimen/mii-exa-mikrobio-probe-katheterspitze and Specimen/mii-exa-mikrobio-probe

You can also check for usages in the FHIR IG Statistics
